AI Overview
You can play the daily animal guessing game on Metazooa. 
How to Play
Objective: Identify a hidden mystery animal on the evolutionary tree of life in 20 guesses or fewer. 
Mechanics: Type an animal name as your guess. The game reveals how your guess is related to the mystery animal using biological classification (such as kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species). 
Daily Reset: A new puzzle launches every day at midnight UTC (7:00 PM Eastern Time).
